app.name: MuxMultiTool
app.tagline: A self-hostable ffmpeg GUI for lossless cutting, remuxing and stream selection.

theme.noToggle: {family} has one variant; pick another family in Settings

help.title: Help
help.body: Keyboard shortcuts and a short guide per screen appear here once the editors exist. Until then, every screen explains which feature it is waiting for.

codes.internal: The backend hit an internal error

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.empty: No jobs yet. Every operation that writes output shows up here with its progress and log.

connection.reconnecting: The connection to the job queue was lost. Reconnecting…

detail.noRawOutput: ffmpeg wrote nothing before it stopped.
detail.logEmpty: ffmpeg has not written anything yet.
detail.command: The exact command this job runs
detail.commandPending: The command arrives with the job details.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this job?
cancelDialog.running: {name} is running. ffmpeg stops now and whatever it has written so far stays on disk.
cancelDialog.queued: {name} is waiting in the queue and will be removed from it.

filePicker.title: Choose files
filePicker.description: Browse the media folders and choose what to open.
filePicker.descriptionDirectory: Browse the media folders and choose one.
filePicker.noMatches: No files of the accepted types here ({extensions}).

files.description: Browse the media folders, select files by wildcard and read the per-stream report.

streams.description: Pick the streams to keep, apply filter rules by language, codec or id, and preview the ffmpeg command.

combine.description: Copy streams between files and build one output from several sources.

cut.description: Player, timeline with thumbnails and waveform, segments, keyframe, normal and smart cut.
cut.empty: Open a file to play its preview; the timeline and the segment list come with the editor.

images.description: GIF, snapshots, cover art and lossless crop.

batch.description: Apply an operation to every matching file in a folder, with a filename template and a preview.

presets.description: Saved operations, reusable from every screen.

settings.description: Appearance, shortcuts, paths and the ffmpeg capability check.
settings.markLight: Use {variant} when the system is light
settings.markDark: Use {variant} when the system is dark
settings.autoHint: Follows the OS: {light} when the system is light, {dark} when it is dark.
settings.sameVariantHint: A family without a light variant uses the same variant for both.
settings.later: Material and GitHub follow after the MVP.
settings.saveError: The theme could not be saved on the server; it is kept in this browser only.

tree.label: Folders
tree.noRoots: No media folders are configured. Mount one and set MMT_MEDIA_ROOTS.

pattern.label: Pattern
pattern.hint: Wildcards: * any run, ? one character, [abc] one of a set. Several patterns separated by spaces.
pattern.added: {n} file added ({matched} matched) | {n} files added ({matched} matched)

table.caption: {folder} · {files} file · {selected} selected | {folder} · {files} files · {selected} selected
table.selectAll: Select every file in this folder
table.name: Name
table.empty: No media files in this folder.

report.title: Stream report · {n} file | Stream report · {n} files
report.empty: Select files above, or by wildcard, to see their streams here.
report.measureHint: Reads every selected file once to sum the packets of each stream. Sizes marked ~ are estimates.
report.pending: Waiting for the report of {n} file… | Waiting for the reports of {n} files…
report.selectStream: Show the details of stream {index} of {name}

details.title: Details · {name} #{index}
details.empty: Click a stream in the report to see everything ffprobe knows about it.

merge.description: Join files with identical codecs without re-encoding, after a compatibility check.
merge.needTwo: Select at least two files to merge.
merge.resolve: Resolve {n} problem first | Resolve {n} problems first

order.title: Order
order.empty: No files yet. Select files on the Files screen, or add them here.

check.title: Compatibility check
check.droppedNote: {n} stream left out of the merge. This stays lossless. | {n} streams left out of the merge. This stays lossless.

output.title: Output
output.hint: A full path, or a file name next to the first file. Empty uses the placeholder name. The file must not exist yet.

engine.label: {engine}
engine.none: This browser cannot decode H.264/AAC through MediaSource and has no HLS player of its own, so the preview cannot play. On Linux Firefox, install the system ffmpeg libraries (libavcodec); otherwise use another browser.

player.fatal: Playback failed: {detail}. Reopen the file to start the preview again.

transport.noKeyframes: Keyframe positions are not known for this file yet
transport.timecode: Current timecode; type a time such as 1:02:03.456 and press Enter to seek

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.body: Fixed shortcuts; they work while no text field has the focus.
